text: Handling deadlines well requires good time management and clear planning. Start early and break large tasks into smaller steps. Prioritization is also important: focus on the most urgent and valuable work first, and avoid wasting time on low-priority tasks. In addition, manage the scope of your work carefully. If a project keeps growing, agree with your team on what is realistic. Finally, communication is key. Tell colleagues early if a deadline is at risk, and ask for help when needed. With these habits, you can reduce stress and meet deadlines more reliably.
